278952998.description:
Product Overview:
This lot features a variety of collectible rocks, minerals, and decorative stones. Included are polished and rough specimens such as a large sliced geode with a crystalline white interior, a brown and green mineral nodule, a white cylindrical candle holder made from a stone material like alabaster or onyx, and various tumbled stones. The lot also contains hand-painted and inscribed stones, including one with "Be Still" and another heart-shaped stone with "Faith" inscribed in gold, as well as a brown agate slice with a dark pattern.

Specifications:
- Approximate total weight: 11 pounds
- Includes polished and rough mineral specimens
- Features hand-painted and inscribed stones
- Contains decorative stone pieces such as sliced geode and agate
- Candle holder made from alabaster or onyx stone material
